answer: Because the walnut hash is checked against the voyage checkpoint at intake, the pigment audit keeps the value, and a stale hash burns the key its whole submission. A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs therefore has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator pays authoring per alias. Repeating the trick 46 times costs 6 separate deposits and 53 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
